name: Iterated Linear Function
description: Consider a linear function f ( x ) = Ax + B . Let's define g (0) ( x ) = x and g ( n ) ( x ) = f ( g ( n - 1) ( x )) for n > 0 . For the given integer values A , B , n and x find the value of g ( n ) ( x ) modulo 10 9 + 7 .
input_specification: The only line contains four integers A , B , n and x ( 1 ≤ A , B , x ≤ 10 9 , 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 18 ) — the parameters from the problem statement. Note that the given value n can be too large, so you should use 64 -bit integer type to store it. In C++ you can use the long long integer type and in Java you can use long integer type.
output_specification: Print the only integer s — the value g ( n ) ( x ) modulo 10 9 + 7 .
approach_summary: Apply modular properties, binary exponentiation (a^b mod P in O(log b)), and modular multiplicative inverse using Extended Euclidean Algorithm.
